source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Earth's climate system (PDF 178).

blocks.text: Zameen ka mausam (climate) kisi ilaqe mein darja hararat, barish, hawa aur doosre mausami halaat ka taveel naqsha hai. Yeh hamare sayyare ke tamam jandaron aur qudrati nizamon par asar karta hai. Mausam qudrati awamil, jaise Sooraj aur samandari dhaaron, aur insani sargarmiyon, jaise fossil fuels jalana aur jangal kaatna, se banta hai. Mausam samajhna mausami tabdeeli ke asraat ke liye tayyari aur un ki kami mein madad deta hai.

Mausami nizam ke yeh paanch hisse mil kar kaam karte aur aik doosre par asar karte hain, is liye aik hisse ki tabdeeli doosron mein tabdeeli la sakti hai (Fig 21.10). Maslan pighalti barf gehri zameen aur samandar ko khol deti hai jo zyada dhoop jazb kar ke fiza ko mazeed garam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein mausami nizam ka daira do-rukhi teeron se paanch dabbon se jura: atmosphere (hawa), hydrosphere (pani, samandar), cryosphere (barf, permafrost), lithosphere (chattani oopri tah) aur biosphere (jandaar). Note: dhoop nizam chalati aur aik hisse ki tabdeeli doosron ko badalti.
blocks.caption: Zameen ka mausami nizam aur us ke paanch baahami hisse (Fig 21.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Hisse musalsal tawanai, pani aur gases ka tabadla karte hain. Isi liye mausam ko aik jure hue nizam ki tarah parhna parta hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar zameen achanak ghoomna band kar de to hawaon aur samandari dhaaron par kya asar hoga?
blocks.explanation: Coriolis ka mor na hota, is liye hawa garam (khat-e-istiwa) aur thande (qutbi) ilaqon ke darmiyan zyada seedhi behti; ghoomne par munhasir mure hawa ke patte (trade winds, westerlies) aur gol samandari gyres zyada tar khatam ho jate. (Achanak rukne se tabah-kun hawayein bhi chaltin, kyunke fiza harkat karti rehti.)

items: Mausam: mausam ka taveel naqsha; qudrati aur insani asraat.
Paanch hisse: atmosphere, hydrosphere, cryosphere, lithosphere, biosphere, sab baahami.
